sentence: Change a staff member's role or facility in Mega-Net EHR Cloud.
You need the Org Admin role.
You will find the person, change the form, and save.
Open the menu, and choose Staff Directory.
Type part of the person's name or email in the filter box.
Choose the row of a person whose status is Active.
Their details load into the form below.
The form shows their first name, last name, email, role, and facility.
Change the role, the facility, or both.
The facility is the site they are assigned to.
Choose Save.
A message confirms the update, and the row shows the new role and facility.
Saving also saves the name and email exactly as they appear in the form.
So check them before you save.
To start over without saving, choose Clear.
You cannot change your own record on this screen.
It tells you so if you try.
To recap: find the person, change the role or facility, and choose Save.
That is how you change a role or a facility.
Questions? Message Mega-Net Software on WhatsApp.
